items.statement: At her campaign's symbolic closing in Plovdiv on 23 October 2026, Yotova thanked BSP, Progressive Bulgaria, VMRO, NDSV and the party of Dr Petar Dertliev for their support - the fullest public list of party endorsements for her candidacy. This confirms all five formations named in the claim, including NDSV and Dr Dertliev's party, which she did not repeat in the 29 October debate.
items.quote: Тя благодари за подкрепата и на най-старата партия БСП и на най-новата „Прогресивна България“, на ВМРО, НДСВ, на партията на д-р Дертлиев.
items.source: ДУМА (Duma) - „Илияна Йотова и Кирил Вълчев закриха предизборната си кампания символно – в зала „Съединение“ в Пловдив“

items.statement: Mediapool's report on the runoff identifies Yotova as the candidate backed by Progressive Bulgaria and BSP and Gyurov as the candidate backed by Democratic Bulgaria and Continue the Change (PP). It gives no indication that Gyurov was backed by any other parliamentary party at the time of the 29 October debate.
items.quote: На втория тур на президентските избори, които ще се проведат тази неделя, един срещу друг за поста държавен глава се изправят подкрепяната от "Прогресивна България" и БСП Илияна Йотова и подкрепяният от "Демократична България" и "Продължаваме промяната" Андрей Гюров.
items.source: Mediapool.bg - „Витанов обвини Гюров, че се е срещал с Пеевски. Кандидатът за президент отрече (обновена)“

items.statement: On 30 October 2026, the last campaign day, GERB leader Boyko Borisov personally endorsed Gyurov-Kandev by joining a declaration signed by former president Rosen Plevneliev, former prime ministers Ivan Kostov and Nikolay Denkov, diplomats and retired officers. The same declaration warned that the Black Sea is turning into a military zone, which contradicts the suggestion that the camp behind Gyurov treated Black Sea security as a 'banal topic'. This was a personal/elite endorsement after the debate, not a formal GERB nomination of Gyurov.
items.quote: Лидерът на ГЕРБ Бойко Борисов подкрепи кандидатпрезидентската двойка Андрей Гюров и Георги Кандев, като се присъедини към обща декларация на президента Росен Плевнелиев, бивши премиери, министри, дипломати и военни от резерва.
items.source: Vesti.bg - „Бойко Борисов подкрепи Гюров и Кандев с декларация на политици и общественици“

items.statement: The runoff was set for Sunday 1 November 2026. Campaigning ended at midnight on 30 October and Saturday 31 October was the legally protected day of reflection, when no campaigning or publication of opinion polls was allowed. This fixes the chronology: the debate was on 29 October, the last campaign day on 30 October, silence on 31 October, and the vote on 1 November.
items.quote: Агитацията приключва в полунощ, а на 31 октомври е ден за размисъл. На 1 ноември Илияна Йотова и Андрей Гюров ще се борят за президентския пост.
items.source: Fakti.bg - „Последен ден на кампанията преди президентския балотаж“

items.statement: In the 29 October BNT debate Yotova asserted that 'some of the formations supporting Mr Gyurov' had sought the official support of DPS-Novo Nachalo, and asked what Gyurov had promised them. Gyurov replied that he had never sought and would never seek support from party headquarters. No document, joint statement or DPS confirmation of such a request was found; the assertion is a campaign allegation by the Yotova camp.
items.quote: Днес видях, че част от формациите, които подкрепят г-н Гюров, потърсиха официалната подкрепа на "ДПС - Ново начало". И се чудя, какво им обещахте, г-н Гюров?
items.source: 168 chasa / 24 chasa - „Йотова атакува с аргументи, Гюров - не е разочарован, че го е направил служебен премиер“

items.statement: On 29 October the chairman of Progressive Bulgaria's parliamentary group, Petar Vitanov, alleged on 7/8 TV that Gyurov had met DPS leader Delyan Peevski on 27 October to negotiate support; Gyurov publicly denied any such meeting and any backroom deal with party headquarters. Vitanov gave no evidence, and Mediapool presents the claim as an accusation that Gyurov rejected.
items.quote: Не правя задкулисни договорки с политически централи. С нито една. Не съм се срещал с партийни лидери, за да договарям подкрепа. Няма и да го направя.
items.source: Mediapool.bg - „Витанов обвини Гюров, че се е срещал с Пеевски. Кандидатът за президент отрече (обновена)“

items.statement: In the debate Yotova referred to Asen Vasilev as 'the spokesperson of your campaign'. Gyurov did not contest that description in his answer. No source was found that formally appoints Vasilev as campaign spokesperson: he is PP's leader and the most prominent party figure campaigning for Gyurov, so the label is Yotova's characterisation and is only partly supported by his de facto role.
items.quote: Не питам нито Асен Василев, който беше говорител на вашата кампания.
items.source: 168 chasa / 24 chasa - „Йотова атакува с аргументи, Гюров - не е разочарован, че го е направил служебен премиер“

items.statement: Yotova claimed in the debate that 'the leaders behind Mr Gyurov' had dismissed her UN initiative on Black Sea security as a 'banal topic'. She did not name the leaders, and no statement by PP, Democratic Bulgaria, Gyurov or his campaign using that phrase about Black Sea security was found; the claim is an attribution, not a documented quote.
items.quote: А лидерите зад г-н Гюров намериха това за банална тема.
items.source: 168 chasa / 24 chasa - „Йотова атакува с аргументи, Гюров - не е разочарован, че го е направил служебен премиер“

items.statement: Yotova's campaign held its reported symbolic closing event in the 'Saedinenie' hall of the Regional History Museum in Plovdiv on 23 October 2026 - two days before the first round, not on 30-31 October. There she defined the main dividing line with her opponents as peace through negotiations versus 'warmongering'; no closing rally on 30 or 31 October was found in the coverage.
items.quote: Ние искаме мир чрез преговори, а не мир чрез сила, повече оръжия, повече жертви. Не приемаме това войнолюбство.
items.source: ДУМА (Duma) - „Илияна Йотова и Кирил Вълчев закриха предизборната си кампания символно – в зала „Съединение“ в Пловдив“

items.statement: On the final campaign day, 30 October, Yotova's last message was a televised address, not a rally. She did not name Gyurov; she attacked the campaign's tone ('the fire of hatred burns friends and foes alike') and rejected suggestions that some voters should be ashamed of their choice. Campaigning was banned from midnight, and Saturday 31 October was the day of reflection before the Sunday runoff.
items.quote: Пожарът на омразата изгаря еднакво и чужди, и свои. Затова аз никога няма да отвърна със същото.
items.source: BG ON AIR - „Йотова и Гюров с последни послания към избирателите преди балотажа в неделя“

items.statement: The runoff date, 1 November 2026, is listed in art. 154(1) of the Labour Code among Bulgaria's official holidays as the Day of the National Awakeners (Ден на народните будители), but the code makes it a non-attendance day only for educational institutions, not a general non-working day. So the runoff coincided with an official holiday, though most workplaces were open.
items.quote: 1 ноември - Ден на народните будители - неприсъствен за всички учебни заведения
items.source: Lex.bg - Кодекс на труда, чл. 154, ал. 1 (консолидиран текст)

items.statement: Gyurov explicitly denied that his initiative committee included people linked to State Security, saying it had no politically bound people, party leaders or 'people from the DS'. No member of his published 200-plus committee list is identified as a former State Security officer in the list itself or in the coverage reviewed; the DS-related list that circulated during the campaign, produced by PP, concerned Yotova's committee, not Gyurov's.
items.quote: В инициативния ни комитет няма хора, които са политически обвързани, политически лидери, хора от ДС.
items.source: 168 chasa / 24 chasa - „Йотова атакува с аргументи, Гюров - не е разочарован, че го е направил служебен премиер“

open_questions: Did any party or formation backing Gyurov formally request DPS-Novo Nachalo's support? No letter, statement or DPS confirmation was found; Yotova asserted it in the debate and Gyurov denied any approach to party headquarters.
Who exactly are the 'leaders behind Mr Gyurov' whom Yotova says called Black Sea security a 'banal topic'? She named no one, and no such statement by PP, DB or Gyurov was located.
Did Asen Vasilev hold a formal campaign-spokesperson title, or was he only the leading surrogate? The only source for the title is Yotova's own formulation in the debate.

Was there a Yotova closing rally on 30 or 31 October 2026? Coverage shows the symbolic closing on 23 October in Plovdiv and televised addresses on 30 October, with 31 October a legally protected day of reflection.

Has the Commission on Dossiers (comdos.bg) or any court checked the composition of Gyurov's initiative committee for former State Security officers? No such verification was found; the DS list circulated in the campaign concerned Yotova's committee.

Did GERB as a party endorse Gyurov, or only Boyko Borisov personally along with the other signatories of the 30 October declaration? The declaration is framed as a non-partisan appeal by politicians and public figures.
notes: Yotova's party support is documented as Progressive Bulgaria, BSP, VMRO, NDSV and Dr Petar Dertliev's party; Gyurov's support came from Democratic Bulgaria and Continue the Change, with GERB leader Boyko Borisov joining a cross-party declaration for him only on 30 October, after the debate. The claim that Gyurov's backers sought DPS support rests on statements by Yotova and by Progressive Bulgaria's Petar Vitanov, who alleged a Gyurov-Peevski meeting; Gyurov and PP leader Asen Vasilev both denied any deal (Vasilev's denial: https://darik.bg/asen-vasilev-progresivna-balgaria-plashi-gargite-s-oporkata-za-nova-sglobka~549752.html), and the only source describing an actual Peevski-Vasilev bargain is the partisan Duma/Glasove report of 29 October. Yotova's description of Vasilev as Gyurov's campaign spokesperson went unchallenged in the exchange but is not corroborated by any appointment announcement. Her 'banal topic' charge names no one and is undercut by the 30 October declaration warning that the Black Sea is becoming a military zone. The campaign's only 'closing' event was on 23 October in Plovdiv; 30 October was given over to televised addresses and 31 October was the day of reflection, so talk of a 30-31 October closing rally is not supported. The runoff on Sunday 1 November coincided with the Day of the National Awakeners, an official holiday that is a non-attendance day only for schools under art. 154(1) of the Labour Code. The claim about former State Security officers in Gyurov's committee is denied by Gyurov and contradicted by the published list; the campaign's DS accusations ran in the opposite direction, with PP's Venko Sabrutev saying Yotova's committee was 'full of State Security agents' (https://www.actualno.com/politics/iniciativnijat-komitet-na-jotova-e-pylen-s-agenti-na-ds-pp-sys-streli-po-edin-ot-kandidat-prezidentite-news_2638103.html).
